title: Lab: Debug a CrashLooping Deployment
intro_md: The `api` deployment is crash-looping in the `shop` namespace. Diagnose it the way an on-call engineer would: observe, describe, read last words, fix, verify.

steps.mock_output:
NAME                   READY  STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
api-6d4cf56db9-x2m8p   0/1    CrashLoopBackOff   7 (2m ago) 12m
api-6d4cf56db9-q7r4t   0/1    CrashLoopBackOff   7 (1m ago) 12m
steps.hint: get pods, with the namespace flag.

steps.instruction_md: Describe the failing pod `api-6d4cf56db9-x2m8p` to read its events.
steps.mock_output:
...
Events:
  Warning  BackOff  restarting failed container api
  Normal   Pulled   Successfully pulled image "api:2.1.0"
steps.hint: describe pod <name> — events at the bottom explain most incidents.

steps.instruction_md: The image pulled fine, so read the logs of the PREVIOUS (crashed) container instance.
steps.mock_output:
FATAL: password authentication failed for user "api"
panic: cannot connect to database
steps.hint: kubectl logs with the flag that shows the prior container's output.

steps.instruction_md: Bad DB credentials after a secret rotation. The fixed secret manifest is in `secret.yaml` — apply it to the cluster.
steps.hint: Declarative apply of a manifest file.

steps.instruction_md: Pods only read secrets at start — restart the rollout of deployment `api` in namespace `shop`.
expected_commands: kubectl rollout restart deployment api -n shop
steps.hint: kubectl rollout has a restart verb.

steps.instruction_md: Watch the rollout of deployment `api` until it completes.
steps.hint: rollout status shows progress and blocks until done.
